$comment: Kiorex Account IdP configuration-as-code (KX-04 KA-01..KA-05, KX-22). Single source of truth read by (a) apps/dev-idp (environment 'local') and (b) the Cognito OpenTofu stack (environments 'staging'/'production'). Never put production secrets here: the tofu stack generates client secrets into Secrets Manager. No clinical data in tokens or claims (ADR-013).

scopes.name: kx
scopes.description: Role hints only. Never grants clinical access (ADR-013/BR40).

scopes.name: kx_org
scopes.description: Organisation membership hints (org_id + role hint). Never grants clinical access (ADR-013/BR40).

claimsMapping.$comment: IdP attribute -> token claim. Cognito: custom attributes are declared on the user pool schema (custom:kx_roles etc.) and mapped via the pre-token-generation trigger.

sub.note: Opaque ULID/UUID; never derived from phone or email (KX-04 §03).

kx_orgs.note: KA-09. Only when scope kx_org is requested. Hints only; the product decides permissions (KX-04 section 03).

act.note: KA-06. RFC 8693 actor claim on guardian acting-as tokens: sub = dependant, act.sub = guardian.

acr.note: KA-10. urn:kiorex:acr:basic (phone OTP / federation) or urn:kiorex:acr:mfa (second factor or user-verifying passkey).

amr.note: KA-10. RFC 8176 values (otp, swk, hwk, user, mfa) plus Kiorex extensions 'totp' and 'fed'.

$forbiddenClaimsNote: KA-13 / KX-04 Rev 2.3: patient addresses live in the Kiorex patient profile; professions, licences and verification evidence live in Kiorly (ADR-013, ADR-029). None may appear in any token, userinfo, event or org entry. Edition is a display hint held by Passport and shown by the product; the token carries org_id + role_hint only (KA-14).

tokenLifetimes.$comment: KA-04: access <= 15 min; refresh 30 days with rotation + reuse detection; audience-specific tokens.

mfaPolicy.$comment: KA-03/KA-10: TOTP for privileged/ops/provider roles. The dev IdP enforces TOTP locally (otplib) at login for accounts holding any requiredForRoles role (a user-verifying passkey also satisfies it). Production: Cognito MFA = ON with software token for these groups via pre-auth/step-up.

stepUp.$comment: KA-10. Products require acr=urn:kiorex:acr:mfa and a fresh auth_time for money, clinical and ops actions. The IdP issues a step-up token from POST /api/step-up after TOTP or a user-verifying passkey assertion.

guardianship.$comment: KA-06 (KX-04 sections 03/05). Guardian links expire automatically at the age of majority. TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN: legal confirmation of the age per market and of the accepted evidence types (Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

orgs.$comment: KA-09. Membership = hint only; products decide permissions. No clinical data in orgs, memberships or claims (ADR-013).
orgs.roleHintsNote: KX-04 Rev 2.3 KA09: owner, admin, finance, doctor, physiotherapist, nurse, dispatcher, assistant, front_desk. receptionist/pharmacist/lab_technician/staff are kept for existing memberships and Pharmacy/Lab. Strings only: profession, licence and scope of practice stay in Kiorly (ADR-029); a nursing agency owner/admin is owner/admin of an org whose edition is NURSE.
orgs.editionsNote: KA-14: edition (CLINIC|NURSE) is a DISPLAY HINT on the organisation (KX-04 section 03, ADR-031). One subject may hold memberships in orgs of different editions (solo nurse + agency). The token kx_orgs carries org_id + role_hint only; the product shows the edition.

federation.$comment: KA-11 dev: a second fake upstream IdP (apps/dev-idp/src/fake-upstream.ts). Production uses enterprise SAML/OIDC federation in the managed IdP (phase 4).

production.backchannelLogoutUri: TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN: Kiorex API URL (api.kiorex.com?) per KX-19

clients.name: Kiorex Passport (self-service web)
clients.$comment: The Passport self-service SPA served at /account. First-party; calls the /api account endpoints with its own access token. The dev IdP rewrites the local redirect URIs to its own issuer origin so tests on other ports work.

clients.name: Kiorly Clinic + Kiorly Nurse (provider SSO, KCV-201 seam; ONE client, edition-aware, aud=kiorly-clinic for both editions, KX-04 Rev 2.3)
clients.$comment: Kiorly Nurse is an edition of Kiorly Clinic (ADR-031): same OIDC client, same audience. Local dev: the Nurse edition runs on the same Kiorly web, http://localhost:5174 (CLAUDE.md), so no extra local redirect URI is needed. Production nurse.kiorly.com URIs are TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN (KX-19 domain confirmation).
